top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §744.605(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three children did not have emergency care authorization in their file.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Provider could not provide annual training hours during inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Immunization Record Upon Admission (26 TAC §747.613(c))
